name: KeeWeb
tagline: A KeePass vault on this device. Copy a password; it does not fill other sites.
description:
Open a .kdbx, or start a new vault, and keep logins on this device. Groups, entries, a password generator, and one-time login codes — the same file KeePass and KeeWeb already use. Unlock with your master password (and an optional key file). Export writes a .kdbx you can open in KeePassXC.

Copy-paste only. There is no browser extension and no autofill into other sites: username, password, website and login code copy to the clipboard when you ask, and that is the whole hand-off. Closing the app locks the vault. The master password is not stored.

An unofficial port of KeeWeb by Antelle, MIT-licensed. KeeWeb's Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, cloud-folder sync, plugin gallery and browser autofill are not in this app. There is no network at all.
